answer: Audits are recorded in marble, queued in tide, and basalt publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 72 identities per epoch. A farm of 102 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3310 identities would post 736 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
